title: Mawng Good GUI
description: I just want to add some more color to the VANILLA Minecraft GUI
body:
I made a more colorful and basic GUI to add a little spice to Minecraft GUI but still feel very vanilla.

## CHANGES
Heatlh bar look more vibrant and hunger bar is now EGGS.
![new health bar and hunger, also compatible with AppleSkin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1be71bd3dd97e4818b3e0b6ba03f5d02254aef1.png)
_Also compatible with [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)_

Add color to many Containers
![view more in the gallery](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0643e3ac9f7a02c20d8512e393d01c7602b5dacd.png)
